data.one_liner: Core library for viewing, editing, and manipulating 3D objects in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It provides the core 3D object manipulation, viewing, and editing API converted from three.js and three_dart. It allows users to handle 3D environments, geometries, and rendering primitives within their projects.
use_when: You need to build a custom 3D scene or viewer inside your Flutter application.
You are porting or adapting concepts from three.js into Dart and Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need simple 2D UI layouts or standard widgets without 3D rendering.
You require high-level ready-made gaming engines with full physics out of the box.
strengths: Brings standard three.js paradigms into Flutter.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: WebglRenderer has been separated into its own package.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and potentially companion rendering packages like WebglRenderer depending on your setup.
